recipes.title: Dragon Fruit Frappé
recipes.subtitle: Central

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the dragon fruits into a blender, add the ice cubes, honey, and lime juice and blend until smooth. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Dragon Fruit Frappé Central 4 dragon fruits, peeled and chopped 8 ice cubes 2 tablespoons honey 2 teaspoons lime juice Put the dragon fruits into a blender, add the ice cubes, honey, and lime juice and blend until smooth. Serve.

recipes.title: Water Chestnut Rubies and Emeralds in Coconut Milk
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 250 ml cream soda syrup or green
250 ml grenadine or red sugar syrup
400 g peeled and diced water chestnuts
1 pandan leaf, tied in a knot
250 ml coconut milk ice cubes, crushed to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the cream soda syrup, grenadine, and tapioca flour in separate bowls. Divide the water chestnuts between the bowls of red and green sugar syrup and let soak for about 10 minutes or until the chestnuts absorbs the color. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to the bowl of tapioca flour. Shake the bowl until the water chestnuts are well coated with starch.

Have a bowl of ice water ready. Bring 1.2 liters water to a boil in a pan, add the coated water chestnuts, and let sit for 3-4 minutes until the water chestnuts float to the surface and the flour has become transparent (jellylike). Transfer to the bowl of ice water and set aside.

Bring 250 ml water and the sugar to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Boil until the mixture turns syrupy, then remove from the heat, let cool, and set aside. Heat the pandan leaf and coconut milk in a pan over low-medium heat for 3-4 minutes or until it reaches a boil. Remove from the heat, let cool, and set aside.
Drain the water chestnuts and spoon into a serving bowl. Add the sugar syrup, and infused coconut milk, and crushed ice cubes and serve.

recipes.searchText: Water Chestnut Rubies and Emeralds in Coconut Milk Central 250 ml cream soda syrup or green 250 ml grenadine or red sugar syrup 100-200 g tapioca flour 400 g peeled and diced water chestnuts 200 g superfine (caster) sugar 1 pandan leaf, tied in a knot 250 ml coconut milk ice cubes, crushed to serve Put the cream soda syrup, grenadine, and tapioca flour in separate bowls. Divide the water chestnuts between the bowls of red and green sugar syrup and let soak for about 10 minutes or until the chestnuts absorbs the color. Remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to the bowl of tapioca flour. Shake the bowl until the water chestnuts are well coated with starch. Have a bowl of ice water ready. Bring 1.2 liters water to a boil in a pan, add the coated water chestnuts, and let sit for 3-4 minutes until the water chestnuts float to the surface and the flour has become transparent (jellylike). Transfer to the bowl of ice water and set aside. Bring 250 ml water and the sugar to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Boil until the mixture turns syrupy, then remove from the heat, let cool, and set aside. Heat the pandan leaf and coconut milk in a pan over low-medium heat for 3-4 minutes or until it reaches a boil. Remove from the heat, let cool, and set aside. Drain the water chestnuts and spoon into a serving bowl. Add the sugar syrup, and infused coconut milk, and crushed ice cubes and serve.

recipes.title: Asiatic Pennywort Juice
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 20 g Asiatic pennywort leaves, washed thoroughly
2 tablespoons sugar syrup (see left) ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the leaves in a blender, add 250 ml recently boiled water, and process until smooth. Strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug) to remove the residue.

Carefully pour 250 ml boiling water over the residue into the pitcher and squeeze the cheesecloth to extract the liquid Discard the residue. Add the sugar syrup to the juice, stir well, and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.searchText: Asiatic Pennywort Juice Central 20 g Asiatic pennywort leaves, washed thoroughly 2 tablespoons sugar syrup (see left) ice cubes, to serve Put the leaves in a blender, add 250 ml recently boiled water, and process until smooth. Strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug) to remove the residue. Carefully pour 250 ml boiling water over the residue into the pitcher and squeeze the cheesecloth to extract the liquid Discard the residue. Add the sugar syrup to the juice, stir well, and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.title: Kumquat Juice
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 tablespoon salt ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Wash the kumquats and squeeze the juice into a large pan. Pour in 2 liters water and stir until mixed. Add the sugar and salt, then bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from the heat, strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug), and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.searchText: Kumquat Juice Central 1 kg kumquats 1 kg superfine (caster) sugar 1 tablespoon salt ice cubes, to serve Wash the kumquats and squeeze the juice into a large pan. Pour in 2 liters water and stir until mixed. Add the sugar and salt, then bring to a boil over medium heat. Remove from the heat, strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug), and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Juice
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1⁄2 teaspoon salt ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 2 liters water to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the lemongrass, and simmer for 8-10 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain the lemongrass juice through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug). Add the sugar and salt and stir until dissolved. Pour the lemongrass juice into a clean pan and bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove from the heat and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes:.

recipes.searchText: Lemongrass Juice Central 500 g chopped lemongrass stalks 300 g superfine (caster) sugar 1⁄2 teaspoon salt ice cubes, to serve Bring 2 liters water to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the lemongrass, and simmer for 8-10 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain the lemongrass juice through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a large heatproof pitcher (jug). Add the sugar and salt and stir until dissolved. Pour the lemongrass juice into a clean pan and bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove from the heat and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes:.

recipes.title: Passion Fruit Juice
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 teaspoon salt Ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 350 ml water to a boil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sugar and stir until dissolved and syrupy, then remove from the heat.
Strain the passion fruit pulp through cheesecloth into a large heatproof pitcher and discard the residue.
Add the salt and 120 ml of the sugar syrup and stir well.
Serve cold over ice.

recipes.searchText: Passion Fruit Juice Northeast 200 g superfine (caster) sugar 1 kg passion fruit, halved 1 teaspoon salt Ice cubes, to serve Bring 350 ml water to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the sugar and stir until dissolved and syrupy, then remove from the heat. Strain the passion fruit pulp through cheesecloth into a large heatproof pitcher and discard the residue. Add the salt and 120 ml of the sugar syrup and stir well. Serve cold over ice.

recipes.title: Pandan Juice
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 x 30 g pandan leaves, washed and cut crosswise into 5-7.5 cm strips
50 g granulated sugar A pinch of salt Ice cubes, to serve (optional)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 1.4 liters water to a boil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the pandan leaves, reduce the heat to medium-low, and boil for 5 minutes.
Add the sugar and salt and boil for another 2-3 minutes, until dissolved.
Remove from the heat and adjust the sweetness to taste.
Strain through a fine sieve into a heatproof pitcher. Serve hot, or cold over ice.

recipes.searchText: Pandan Juice Northeast 5 x 30 g pandan leaves, washed and cut crosswise into 5-7.5 cm strips 50 g granulated sugar A pinch of salt Ice cubes, to serve (optional) Bring 1.4 liters water to a boil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the pandan leaves, reduce the heat to medium-low, and boil for 5 minutes. Add the sugar and salt and boil for another 2-3 minutes, until dissolved. Remove from the heat and adjust the sweetness to taste. Strain through a fine sieve into a heatproof pitcher. Serve hot, or cold over ice.

recipes.title: Roselle Juice
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 200 g fresh roselle (or 20 g dried roselle). cleaned
4 teaspoons salt ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 2 liters of water to a boil in a large pan. Add the roselle, reduce the heat, and simmer gently until the water turns dark red. Remove the roselle with a slotted spoon, add the sugar and salt, and bring back to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes, then remove from the heat and flavor to taste. Pour into a heatproof pitcher (jug) and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.searchText: Roselle Juice North 200 g fresh roselle (or 20 g dried roselle). cleaned 200 g granulated sugar 4 teaspoons salt ice cubes, to serve Bring 2 liters of water to a boil in a large pan. Add the roselle, reduce the heat, and simmer gently until the water turns dark red. Remove the roselle with a slotted spoon, add the sugar and salt, and bring back to a boil. Boil for 10 minutes, then remove from the heat and flavor to taste. Pour into a heatproof pitcher (jug) and let cool. Serve cold with ice cubes.

recipes.title: Sweetened Soy Milk
recipes.subtitle: Central

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Rinse the soybeans until the water becomes clear, then soak in 750 ml water for at least 6 hours. Drain and discard the soaking water.

Finely pound the soybeans in a mortar with a pestle, then transfer to a large bowl, pour in 1.7 liters water, and stir well. Strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a pan, discarding the residue left in the cheesecloth.

Bring the soy milk to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously for 5 minutes. Add the sugar, reduce the heat to low, and stir for 5-10 minutes or until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat and serve hot or cold.

recipes.searchText: Sweetened Soy Milk Central 160 g soybeans, peeled 100 g superfine (caster) sugar Rinse the soybeans until the water becomes clear, then soak in 750 ml water for at least 6 hours. Drain and discard the soaking water. Finely pound the soybeans in a mortar with a pestle, then transfer to a large bowl, pour in 1.7 liters water, and stir well. Strain through a piece of cheesecloth (muslin) into a pan, discarding the residue left in the cheesecloth. Bring the soy milk to a boil over medium heat, stirring continuously for 5 minutes. Add the sugar, reduce the heat to low, and stir for 5-10 minutes or until the sugar has dissolved. Remove from the heat and serve hot or cold.

recipes.title: Tamarind Juice
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 80 g peeled and seeded sour tamarind pods
250 g granulated sugar ice cubes, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: To make the tamarind puree, soak the tamarind pods in 350 ml warm water for 15-20 minutes. Use your hand to squeeze the tamarind and water to mix and remove the tamarind flesh until you have quite a thick puree. Strain the tamarind mixture through a fine strainer (sieve) into a cup. Set aside. Bring 950 ml water to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tamarind puree, salt, and sugar and stir until the sugar has dissolved, then boil for 4-5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Serve hot or cold with ice cubes.

recipes.searchText: Tamarind Juice Northeast 80 g peeled and seeded sour tamarind pods 1⁄2 teaspoons salt 250 g granulated sugar ice cubes, to serve To make the tamarind puree, soak the tamarind pods in 350 ml warm water for 15-20 minutes. Use your hand to squeeze the tamarind and water to mix and remove the tamarind flesh until you have quite a thick puree. Strain the tamarind mixture through a fine strainer (sieve) into a cup. Set aside. Bring 950 ml water to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the tamarind puree, salt, and sugar and stir until the sugar has dissolved, then boil for 4-5 minutes. Remove from the heat. Serve hot or cold with ice cubes.

recipes.title: Spicy Egg Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered lengthwise
5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Arrange the eggs on a serving plate.
Stir the shallots, chiles, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar together in a bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Pour the dressing over the eggs, garnish with the cilantro leaves, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Egg Salad Central 4 hard-boiled eggs, peeled and quartered lengthwise 2 shallots, sliced lengthwise 5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped 21⁄2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 tablespoons lime juice 11⁄2 tablespoons superfine (caster) sugar 1 handful cilantro (coriander) leaves Arrange the eggs on a serving plate. Stir the shallots, chiles, fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar together in a bowl until the sugar dissolves. Pour the dressing over the eggs, garnish with the cilantro leaves, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Salted Egg Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 yard-long bean, cut into 8 cm pieces
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
2 salted duck eggs, cut into quarters lengthwise

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle.
Add the yard-long bean, tomatoes, papaya, and dried shrimp and mix together.
Season with the lime juice, sugar, and fish sauce and mix well.
Add the eggs and gently stir with a spoon.
Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with the peanuts, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Salted Egg Salad Central 5-6 red bird's eye chiles 3-4 cloves garlic 1 yard-long bean, cut into 8 cm pieces 3 small tomatoes 175 g julienned green papaya 2 tablespoons dried shrimp 1-2 tablespoons lime juice 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 tablespoon fish sauce 2 salted duck eggs, cut into quarters lengthwise 2 tablespoons roasted peanuts, to garnish Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Add the yard-long bean, tomatoes, papaya, and dried shrimp and mix together. Season with the lime juice, sugar, and fish sauce and mix well. Add the eggs and gently stir with a spoon. Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with the peanuts, and serve.

recipes.title: Thai Rice Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400 g jasmine rice, rinsed and drained
200 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined

ingredientGroups.heading: For the dressing
lines: 50 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the dressing, bring the fish sauce and 250 ml water to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the sugar, lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal and return to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.

Remove from the heat and strain through cheesecloth (muslin) into a clean pan. Discard the solids. Return the liquid to the heat, bring to a boil, then simmer for another 5-7 minutes until thickened and reduced by half. Set aside.

For the rice salad, process the morinda leaves in a blender. Strain through cheesecloth into a bowl or pitcher, add 600 ml water, and stir. Put the rice in a pan, add enough morinda water to cover, bring to a boil over medium heat, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook the shrimp in boiling water for 1-2 minutes until pink. Drain, pound to a smooth paste, then toast the paste in a wok for 5-7 minutes until dry. Set aside.
Dry-fry the grated coconut in a clean wok for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Remove from the heat and set aside.
Soak the vermicelli in water for 10 minutes, or according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.
Bring the coconut milk to a boil in a wok over medium heat. Add the salt, sugar, and noodles and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until dry.
Mix all the rice-salad ingredients together and serve with the dressing and side dishes.

Add the sugar, lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal and return to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes. Remove from the heat and strain through cheesecloth (muslin) into a clean pan. Discard the solids. Return the liquid to the heat, bring to a boil, then simmer for another 5-7 minutes until thickened and reduced by half. Set aside. For the rice salad, process the morinda leaves in a blender. Strain through cheesecloth into a bowl or pitcher, add 600 ml water, and stir. Put the rice in a pan, add enough morinda water to cover, bring to a boil over medium heat, and simmer for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, cook the shrimp in boiling water for 1-2 minutes until pink. Drain, pound to a smooth paste, then toast the paste in a wok for 5-7 minutes until dry. Set aside. Dry-fry the grated coconut in a clean wok for 3-4 minutes, stirring constantly, until golden brown. Remove from the heat and set aside. Soak the vermicelli in water for 10 minutes, or according to the package directions. Drain and set aside. Bring the coconut milk to a boil in a wok over medium heat. Add the salt, sugar, and noodles and stir-fry for 3-5 minutes until dry. Mix all the rice-salad ingredients together and serve with the dressing and side dishes.

recipes.title: Spicy Fish Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 kg sea bass or sea bream, cleaned and filleted
65 g pea eggplants, grilled and pounded

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Finely chop the fish, then cook in a large skillet or frying pan for 2-3 minutes. Set aside. Mix the chili flakes, ground rice, shallots, scallion (spring onion), cilantro (coriander), and sawtooth cilantro (coriander) together in a bowl. Add the fish sauce, fermented fish sauce, galangal, and eggplant (aubergine), and mix well. Sprinkle with the mint leaves and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Fish Salad Northeast 1 kg sea bass or sea bream, cleaned and filleted 30 g dried chili flakes 2 teaspoons Ground Toasted Rice (see p. 64) 4 shallots, chopped 40 g chopped scallions 28 g chopped cilantro 50 g chopped sawtooth cilantro 1 tablespoon fish sauce 11⁄2 tablespoons fermented fish sauce 1 tablespoon finely minced galangal 65 g pea eggplants, grilled and pounded 20 g chopped mint leaves Finely chop the fish, then cook in a large skillet or frying pan for 2-3 minutes. Set aside. Mix the chili flakes, ground rice, shallots, scallion (spring onion), cilantro (coriander), and sawtooth cilantro (coriander) together in a bowl. Add the fish sauce, fermented fish sauce, galangal, and eggplant (aubergine), and mix well. Sprinkle with the mint leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Seaweed Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 500 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
100 g red and green bird's-eye chiles
350 g sliced shallots Betel leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the seaweed in a bow of water for 1 hour then drain and set aside.

Mix the coconut cream, tamarind, sugar, salt, and shrimp paste together in a large pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove from the heat and let stand until warm. Add the soaked seaweed, the peanuts, dried shrimp, coconut chiles, and shallot and mix together. Put a tablespoon of the salad into the center of a betel leaf. Repeat until all the salad s used. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Seaweed Salad South 350 g dried Gracilaria seaweed 250 ml coconut cream 350 ml Tamarind Puree (see p. 63) 500 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 11⁄2 teaspoons salt 100 g shrimp paste 650 g roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped 100 g dried shrimp, coarsely chopped 500 g coconut meat, roasted 100 g red and green bird's-eye chiles 350 g sliced shallots Betel leaves, to serve Soak the seaweed in a bow of water for 1 hour then drain and set aside. Mix the coconut cream, tamarind, sugar, salt, and shrimp paste together in a large pan. Bring to a boil over medium heat, then remove from the heat and let stand until warm. Add the soaked seaweed, the peanuts, dried shrimp, coconut chiles, and shallot and mix together. Put a tablespoon of the salad into the center of a betel leaf. Repeat until all the salad s used. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Mackerel Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 x 150 g steamed salted horse mackerel, or 150 g smoked mackerel
7 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped
1 x 5⁄8-inch/11⁄2 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the horse mackerel and fry for 2-3 minutes on each side. Remove and let cool.
Remove the skin and bones and put the flesh in a large bowl. Gently crumble it into small pieces.
Add the shallots, chiles, lemongrass, ginger, lime juice, and fish sauce and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with the peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Mackerel Salad Central 120 ml vegetable oil 2 x 150 g steamed salted horse mackerel, or 150 g smoked mackerel 3 shallots, finely sliced lengthwise 7 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped 3 lemongrass stalks, finely sliced 1 x 5⁄8-inch/11⁄2 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned 11⁄2 tablespoons lime juice 2 tablespoons fish sauce 1 handful peppermint leaves, to garnish Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the shallots, chiles, lemongrass, ginger, lime juice, and fish sauce and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with the peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Squid and Heart of Palm Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g squid, cleaned and cut into 4 cm pieces
100 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails still intact

ingredientGroups.heading: For the dressing
lines: 10 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the squid in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until pink. Drain and set aside.
For the dressing, mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and chiles in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Add the squid, shrimp, heart of palm, mango, carrot, onion, cilantro, and scallions. Mix well and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Squid and Heart of Palm Salad South 300 g squid, cleaned and cut into 4 cm pieces 100 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails still intact 150 g heart of palm, julienned 80 g julienned sour green mango 100 g shredded carrots 1 onion, sliced lengthwise 10 g chopped cilantro (coriander) 5 scallions (spring onions), sliced lengthwise 21⁄2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 tablespoons lime juice 11⁄2 tablespoons granulated sugar 10 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped Blanch the squid in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Drain and set aside. Blanch the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until pink. Drain and set aside. For the dressing, mix the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and chiles in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves. Add the squid, shrimp, heart of palm, mango, carrot, onion, cilantro, and scallions. Mix well and serve.

recipes.title: Deep Fried Squid Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g squid, cut into 1 cm-thick rings
2 lemongrass stalks, finely sliced Peppermint leaves, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Whisk the flour and cold water together until thoroughly combined.

Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C. Dip the squid in the batter, carefully add it to the oil, and deep-fry for 4-5 minutes, until golden and crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Mix the chili jam, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, shallot, kaffir lime leaves, chiles, and lemongrass in a bowl.
Add the squid and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Deep Fried Squid Salad Central 75 g all-purpose (plain) flour 75 ml cold water 475 ml vegetable oil, for deep-frying 300 g squid, cut into 1 cm-thick rings 2 tablespoons Chili Jam (see p. 35) 2 tablespoons lime juice 2 tablespoons fish sauce 1⁄2 teaspoon granulated sugar 1 shallot, sliced 3 kaffir lime leaves, finely sliced 5 red bird's-eye chiles, chopped 2 lemongrass stalks, finely sliced Peppermint leaves, to garnish Whisk the flour and cold water together until thoroughly combined. Heat the oil in a wok or deep fryer to 350°F/180°C. Dip the squid in the batter, carefully add it to the oil, and deep-fry for 4-5 minutes, until golden and crisp. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Mix the chili jam, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, shallot, kaffir lime leaves, chiles, and lemongrass in a bowl. Add the squid and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Wing Bean Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 12 uncooked jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact
40 g cashew nuts Peppermint leaves, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Cook the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes, or until they turn pink, then drain and set aside.
Fill a bowl with ice-cold water and set aside.
Blanch the wing beans in a pan of boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain and transfer to the ice water for 1 minute.
Drain the beans, slice them into 5 mm-thick slices, and set aside.
To make the sauce, mix all the sauce ingredients together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined.
Add the shrimp, squid, cashew nuts, and wing beans and mix well.
Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Wing Bean Salad Central 12 uncooked jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined, with tails still intact 20 wing beans 25 g finely sliced dried squid 40 g cashew nuts Peppermint leaves, to garnish 3 shallots, sliced 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes 2 tablespoons fish sauce 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 3 teaspoons lime juice 1 tablespoon Chili Jam (see p. 35) Cook the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes, or until they turn pink, then drain and set aside. Fill a bowl with ice-cold water and set aside. Blanch the wing beans in a pan of boiling water for 30 seconds, then drain and transfer to the ice water for 1 minute. Drain the beans, slice them into 5 mm-thick slices, and set aside. To make the sauce, mix all the sauce ingredients together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined. Add the shrimp, squid, cashew nuts, and wing beans and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, garnish with peppermint leaves, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Giant Freshwater Shrimp Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 3-8 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Preheat the broiler (grill) to high. Put the shrimp on the broiler rack and broil for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked. Let cool slightly, remove the shells, and press the juices from the heads.
Put the shrimp in a bowl, add the remaining ingredients, and mix until thoroughly combined. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Giant Freshwater Shrimp Salad Central 4 uncooked giant freshwater shrimp (prawns) 3 shallots, finely sliced 1 tablespoon fish sauce 1 tablespoon lime juice 1 tablespoon Chili Jam (see p. 35) 3-8 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped 2 cilantro (coriander) sprigs, finely chopped Preheat the broiler (grill) to high. Put the shrimp on the broiler rack and broil for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked. Let cool slightly, remove the shells, and press the juices from the heads. Put the shrimp in a bowl, add the remaining ingredients, and mix until thoroughly combined. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Heart of Palm Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined
10 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped
1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar lettuce leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the pork in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the squid in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until pink. Drain and set aside.

Mix the pork, squid, shrimp, carrots, chiles, shallots, celery, and heart of palm in a large bowl. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar and mix until the sugar dissolves. Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Heart of Palm Salad South 100 g ground (minced) pork 100 g squid, sliced 100 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined 100 g julienned carrots 10 red bird's eye chiles, finely chopped 4-8 shallots, sliced 50 g chopped Chinese celery stalk 100 g heart of palm, julienned 2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar lettuce leaves, to serve Blanch the pork in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Drain and set aside. Blanch the squid in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside. Blanch the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until pink. Drain and set aside. Mix the pork, squid, shrimp, carrots, chiles, shallots, celery, and heart of palm in a large bowl. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar and mix until the sugar dissolves. Serve on lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Seafood Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 150 g squid, sliced into 2 cm-thick rings
180 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon sliced red and green bird's eye chiles
1 handful cilantro (coriander), chopped, plus extra sprigs to garnish
20 g Chinese celery stalk, chopped into 3 cm lengths
5 kaffir lime leaves, chopped (optional) lettuce leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the squid in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
For the dressing, combine the lime juice, fish sauce, and sugar in a small bowl. Add the chicken broth or water and stir until the sugar dissolves.

Put the shrimp, squid, onion, mango, carrot, chiles, tomatoes, cilantro, celery, scallions, lemongrass, kaffir lime leaves, if using, and dressing in a large bowl. Stir 3-4 times until coated. Serve on lettuce leaves and garnish with cilantro sprigs.

recipes.title: Spicy Salad with Shrimp and Pork
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails intact
500 g vegetable hummingbird flowers, stamens removed

ingredientGroups.heading: For the dressing
lines: 10 red and green bird's eye chiles, chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring a pan of water to a boil, add the shrimp, and blanch for 1-2 minutes, or until pink and cooked. Drain and set aside.

Return the water to a boil, add the pork, and blanch for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Drain and set aside. Return the water to a boil once more, add the vegetable hummingbird flowers, and blanch for 1 minute. Drain and set aside.

For the dressing, pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves. Transfer the dressing to a large serving bowl, add the shrimp, pork, and flowers, and mix well. Stir in the shallots and serve.

recipes.title: Glass Noodle Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 50 g squid, sliced into 2 cm-thick rings
10 red bird's-eye chiles, very finely chopped
30 g Chinese celery stalks, sliced into 2.5 cm pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the noodles in water for 10 minutes. Drain, then blanch in boiling water for 1 minute, or cook according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the sliced pork in boiling water for 1-2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Blanch the fish balls in boiling water for 1-2 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Blanch the squid in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside. Blanch the ground pork in boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside.

Put the noodles in a large bowl. Add the sliced pork, fish balls, squid, ground pork, fried fish balls, Chinese fish cake, onion, chiles, sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, cilantro, and Chinese celery. Mix well and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Shrimp and Mango Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 tablespoons julienned sour green mango or shredded carrot

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: To make the dressing, mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and set aside For the salad, mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl, add the dressing, and mix until combined. Garnish with the dried chiles and fried shallot and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Shrimp and Mango Salad South 5 red bird's eye chiles 4 shallots, sliced 1 tablespoon sliced lemongrass 4 teaspoons chopped cilantro (coriander) leaves 2 teaspoons chopped scallion (spring onions) 4 kaffir lime leaves, thinly sliced 2 tablespoons julienned sour green mango or shredded carrot 2 tablespoon roasted cashew nuts 100 g dried shrimp 2 tablespoons lime juice 2 teaspoons fish sauce 2 teaspoons sugar 5 dried red chiles, fried 2 tablespoons Fried Shallot (see p. 64) To make the dressing, mix all the ingredients together in a bowl and set aside For the salad, mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl, add the dressing, and mix until combined. recipes.title: Cilantro Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 90 g pork crackling, cut into small pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop.
Pound the chiles, garlic, ginger, shallots, galangal, lemongrass, cilantro roots, and shrimp paste thoroughly in a mortar with a pestle.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the chili paste, and stir-fry for 2 minutes, or until fragrant, then remove from the heat.
Put the cilantro and pork crackling in a bowl and mix well. Add the chili paste and a pinch of salt and mix well. Sprinkle with the fried garlic and shallots and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Yard-Long Bean and Pork Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: To garnish
lines: 2 tablespoons chopped scallions (spring onions) white sesame seeds (optional)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallots, garlic, salt, and shrimp paste in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Set aside.

Bring a pan of water to a boil. Add the water spinach and blanch for 30 seconds, then transfer to cold water and drain. Add the yard-long beans to the boiling water and blanch for 1 minute, then transfer to cold water and drain. Boil the eggplants and lablab beans separately for 2-3 minutes, then drain. Coarsely chop all the vegetables.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add the pork and stir-fry for 3 minutes, then add the vegetables and stir-fry for 2 minutes. Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with the neem tree tips, shallots, cilantro, scallions, and sesame seeds, if using.

Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with the neem tree tips, shallots, cilantro, scallions, and sesame seeds, if using.

recipes.title: Spicy Dried Buffalo Skin Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the boiler (grill) to medium. Put the buffalo skin on the broiler (grill) rack and char to remove the hairs. Soak the skin in a bowl of water for 3 hours, then drain, transfer to a pan of boiling water, and boil for 20 minutes or until tender. Drain and set aside.

For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in a bowl of warm water for 15 minutes or until rehydrated then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallot, garlic, and salt in a mortar win a pestle until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix until combined. Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat, add the garlic and 11⁄2 teaspoons chili paste and cook for 1 minute or until fragrant. Add the tomatoes, buffalo skin, and 2 tablespoons water and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes. Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with the sesame seeds, and scallion (spring onion) and garnish with the cilantro (coriander) sprig. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Dried Buffalo Skin Salad North 200 g dried buffalo skin, shredded 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 6 cloves garlic, chopped 10 cherry tomatoes, halved 2 tablespoons white sesame seeds 1 tablespoon chopped scallion (spring onion) 1 cilantro (coriander) sprig, to garnish 5 dried red chiles, seeded 3 shallots, coarsely chopped 8 cloves garlic 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon shrimp paste Heat the boiler (grill) to medium. recipes.title: Spicy Pork Liver Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g pork liver, rinsed, drained, and cut into bite-size pieces
1 tablespoon Ground Toasted Rice (see p. 64) Glutinous Rice (see p. 378), to serve raw or steamed vegetables, such as Chinese greens, cucumber, and napa (Chinese) cabbage, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Add the pork liver and blanch for 1-2 minutes, or until medium cooked.
Remove from the heat and add the chili flakes, lime juice, fish sauce, shallot, scallions, sawtooth cilantro, mint leaves, and ground toasted rice and mix well.
Transfer to a serving plate and serve with glutinous rice and raw or steamed vegetables.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Pork Liver Salad Northeast 75 ml chicken broth (stock) 100 g pork liver, rinsed, drained, and cut into bite-size pieces 2 teaspoons dried chili flakes 1 tablespoon lime juice 1 tablespoon fish sauce 1 shallot, sliced lengthwise 3 scallions (spring onions), finely sliced 2 sawtooth cilantro (coriander) leaves, finely sliced 1 handful mint leaves 1 tablespoon Ground Toasted Rice (see p. 64) Glutinous Rice (see p. 378), to serve raw or steamed vegetables, such as Chinese greens, cucumber, and napa (Chinese) cabbage, to serve Bring the broth to a boil in a pan over medium heat. Transfer to a serving plate and serve with glutinous rice and raw or steamed vegetables.

recipes.title: Peanut Curd in Spicy Salad
recipes.subtitle: North
recipes.prepTime: 10 minutes, plus soaking and cooling time

ingredientGroups.heading: For the spicy salad
lines: 1 garlic bulb, cloves separated and finely sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the peanuts in water overnight, then drain. Grind them thoroughly in a mortar with a pestle until fine.

Bring 2 liters water and the ground peanuts to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Stir in the rice flour, then strain through cheesecloth (muslin) into a large, shallow rectangular container. Spread out the curd mixture and leave to cool until solid.

For the salad, cut the peanut curd into 2.5 cm pieces about 3-4 mm thick and place in a large bowl. Add the chili jam, salt, shallot, garlic, and pork and mix together. Add the lime juice, lemon juice, and cilantro and mix well. Sprinkle with the fried garlic and shallots and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Beef Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g thin beef sirloin, tenderloin, or rump steak
1 cucumber, halved lengthwise and sliced into 1 cm-thick pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat a charcoal or gas grill to 400°F/200°C, or preheat an indoor broiler to medium. Put the beef in a shallow dish, add the soy sauce, turn to coat, and marinate for about 10 minutes.
Grill or broil the beef for 4-5 minutes on each side. Remove, slice into strips, and set aside.
For the dressing, stir the fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, and chiles together until the sugar dissolves.
Put the beef, cucumber, tomatoes, shallots, and cilantro in a large bowl. Pour in the dressing, toss lightly, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Beef Salad Central 300 g thin beef sirloin, tenderloin, or rump steak 2 teaspoons soy sauce 1 cucumber, halved lengthwise and sliced into 1 cm-thick pieces 2 tomatoes, quartered 3 shallots, sliced 1 handful sawtooth cilantro (coriander), coarsely chopped 3 tablespoons fish sauce 3 tablespoons lime juice 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 5 red bird's eye chiles, chopped Heat a charcoal or gas grill to 400°F/200°C, or preheat an indoor broiler to medium. Pour in the dressing, toss lightly, and serve.

recipes.title: Chinese Mustard Green Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 60 g chopped Chinese mustard greens (with yellow flowers)
70 g white and black sesame seeds, roasted

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the mustard greens in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and plunge into ice-cold water.
Mix the remaining ingredients in a large bowl. Drain the mustard greens, add them to the bowl, and mix well. Sprinkle with the fried garlic and shallots and serve.

recipes.searchText: Chinese Mustard Green Salad North 60 g chopped Chinese mustard greens (with yellow flowers) 1 tomato, sliced 3 tablespoons chili powder 150 g peanuts, roasted 70 g white and black sesame seeds, roasted 1 teaspoon turmeric 1 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons Fried Garlic (see p. 64) 2 tablespoons Fried Shallots (see p. 64) Blanch the mustard greens in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute, then drain and plunge into ice-cold water. recipes.title: Spicy Round Eggplant and Pork Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: For the chili paste
lines: 8 dried red bird's eye chiles, chopped

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Boil the pork for 3-4 minutes, or until cooked. Drain and pat dry, then pound thoroughly in a mortar. Tear the pork into small pieces and set aside.
Mix 475 ml water with the salt until dissolved. Halve the eggplants lengthwise, slice them lengthwise into 3 mm pieces, and soak in the salt water for 5 minutes.

For the chili paste, soak the dried chiles in warm water for 15 minutes, or until rehydrated, then drain and chop. Pound the chiles, shallots, garlic, galangal, and salt until smooth. Add the shrimp paste and mix thoroughly.

Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the chopped garlic and chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute, or until golden and fragrant. Add the pork and 1 tablespoon water and stir-fry for another 1-2 minutes. Remove from the heat.
Drain the eggplants and mix them with the pork and chili paste. Sprinkle with the cilantro, scallion, peppermint, and Vietnamese cilantro and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Red Ant Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 9 cm piece galangal, peeled and sliced
5 red and green bird's eye chiles, finely chopped

ingredientGroups.heading: For the dressing
lines: 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
To serve wild betel leaves, sliced star gooseberry leaves, sliced young jackfruit, peeled and seeded while wearing gloves, and cut into chunks

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the ants in an airtight container and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes, then transfer to the freezer for 30 minutes.
Roast the ants in a wok over medium heat for 6-8 minutes, or until dry. Set aside.

For the dressing, mix the tamarind, sugar, fermented fish sauce, fish sauce, shrimp paste, lime juice, and salt in a bowl. Transfer to a wok and warm over low heat for 2-3 minutes, or until the sugar dissolves. Remove from the heat and cool.
Add the ants, galangal, lemongrass, chiles, dried shrimp, and peanuts to the cooled dressing and stir until combined. Serve with the wild betel leaves, star gooseberry leaves, and young jackfruit.

recipes.title: Thai Spicy Salad with Giant Water Bug Eggs
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5-7 red and green bird's eye chiles, finely chopped
2 scallions (spring onions), snipped into small lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Heat the oil for deep-frying to 350°F/180°C. Deep-fry the squid and fish bladder for 5 minutes, or until crispy. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.

Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar in a large bowl. Add the crispy fish bladder and squid, cashew nuts, onions, tomato, chiles, sweet shrimp if using, scallions, carrots, mango, celery, and giant water bug eggs. Mix well and serve.

recipes.searchText: Thai Spicy Salad with Giant Water Bug Eggs South 475 ml vegetable oil, for deep-frying 25 g finely sliced dried squid 50 g dried fish bladder 2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 tablespoon granulated sugar 40 g roasted cashew nuts 40 g sliced onions 1⁄2 small tomato, sliced 5-7 red and green bird's eye chiles, finely chopped 30 g sweet shrimp (optional) 2 scallions (spring onions), snipped into small lengths 100 g julienned carrots 165 g julienned sour green mango 1 Chinese celery stalk, chopped 2 tablespoons giant water bug eggs Heat the oil for deep-frying to 350°F/180°C. Deep-fry the squid and fish bladder for 5 minutes, or until crispy. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. Mix the fish sauce, lime juice, and sugar in a large bowl. Add the crispy fish bladder and squid, cashew nuts, onions, tomato, chiles, sweet shrimp if using, scallions, carrots, mango, celery, and giant water bug eggs. Mix well and serve.

recipes.title: Snail and Noodle Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 300 g snakehead fish or catfish, cleaned
1 handful young pink mempat leaves or tamarind leaves, sliced
1 handful chayote shoots or young spinach, sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the snails in tepid water for 1-2 hours, then drain. Soak the noodles in water for 10 minutes, then drain and blanch in boiling water for 1 minute, or according to the package directions. Drain and set aside.

Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. Remove and discard the outer red petals and small white flowers from the banana blossom. Cut off the tip and base, quarter the blossom lengthwise, and place it in the vinegar water. Separate and clean the layers, discard the flowers within, finely slice the leaves to 5 mm thick, and return them to the vinegar water.
Bring 750 ml water to a boil. Add the snails, reduce the heat, and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain, discard the shells, and set aside.
Bring 350 ml water to a boil in another pan. Add the fish and cook for 7-10 minutes. Drain, discard the bones and skin, and tear the flesh into small pieces.

Pound the chili flakes and shallots to a smooth paste. Transfer to a large bowl and add the snails and fish. Drain and rinse the banana blossom, add it with the remaining ingredients, and mix thoroughly. Garnish with the chiles and fried shallots and serve.

Add the snails, reduce the heat, and simmer for 5 minutes. Drain, discard the shells, and set aside. Bring 350 ml water to a boil in another pan. Add the fish and cook for 7-10 minutes. Drain and rinse the banana blossom, add it with the remaining ingredients, and mix thoroughly. Garnish with the chiles and fried shallots and serve.

recipes.title: Pickled Vegetable Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 x 1-inch/3.5-om piece fresh ginger, peeled and sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Leave 3 chiles whole and finely chop the rest, then set aside.
Mix the pickled mustard greens, eggplant (aubergine), and ginger together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with the whole and finely chopped chiles. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Pickled Vegetable Salad Northeast 5 red bird's-eye chiles 120 g sliced pickled mustard greens 2 yellow round eggplants (aubergines), sliced 1 x 1-inch/3.5-om piece fresh ginger, peeled and sliced Leave 3 chiles whole and finely chop the rest, then set aside. Mix the pickled mustard greens, eggplant (aubergine), and ginger together in a large bowl. Sprinkle with the whole and finely chopped chiles. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Shiitake Mushroom Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 230 g fresh shiitake mushrooms, stems discarded
3-5 red and green bird's eye chiles, finely chopped
1 tablespoon mint leaves, to garnish raw vegetables, such as tomatoes, cucumber, lettuce, and cabbage, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the shiitake mushrooms in boiling water for 1 minute, or until cooked. Drain and pat dry, then slice into 5 mm strips and put in a large bowl.
Add the cilantro, shallots, kaffir lime leaves, scallions, garlic, sawtooth cilantro, ground toasted rice, chili flakes, lime juice, lemongrass, chiles, fish sauce, and chicken broth and mix well.
Garnish with the mint leaves and serve with raw vegetables.

Add the cilantro, shallots, kaffir lime leaves, scallions, garlic, sawtooth cilantro, ground toasted rice, chili flakes, lime juice, lemongrass, chiles, fish sauce, and chicken broth and mix well. recipes.title: Spicy Mushroom Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 8-10 jumbo shrimp (king prawns), peeled and deveined
300 g mixed mushrooms, such as straw, king oyster, and shimeji mushrooms
11⁄2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
1 handful cilantro (coriander), coarsely chopped, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the pork in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes or until cooked. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the mushrooms in another pan of boiling water for about 30 seconds. Drain and set aside.
For the dressing, stir the fish sauce, lime juice, chiles, and sugar together in a bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Put the pork, shrimp, mushrooms, scallions, shallots, and dressing in a large bowl and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with cilantro, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Pork, Mushroom, and Seafood Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 25 g chopped sawtooth cilantro (coriander) peppermint leaves, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the squid in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the pork in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Blanch the mushrooms in another pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and set aside.

Mix the pork, seafood, mushrooms, sugar, fish sauce, toasted rice, lime juice, shallots, and chili flakes in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Add the scallions and sawtooth cilantro and mix well. Sprinkle with peppermint leaves and serve.

Mix the pork, seafood, mushrooms, sugar, fish sauce, toasted rice, lime juice, shallots, and chili flakes in a bowl until thoroughly combined. Add the scallions and sawtooth cilantro and mix well. recipes.title: Cucumber Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 yard-long bean, cut into 4 cm lengths
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Coarsely pound the chiles, garlic, and yard-long bean in a mortar with a pestle.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, lime juice, fish sauce, and fermented fish sauce and mix well until the sugar dissolves.
Add the cucumber and crabmeat, if using, and mix gently. Serve.

recipes.title: Mixed Fruit and Vegetable Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
3 tablespoons lead tree seeds lettuce leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. Peel away and discard the outer red petals and small white flowers from the banana blossom. Cut off the tip and stem end, split the blossom in half lengthwise, then halve each piece again and put the quarters into the vinegar water.

Peel and clean each layer, discarding the banana flowers inside. Finely slice the blossom into 3 mm slices and return them to the vinegar water. Repeat until all the leaves have been sliced, then drain, rinse under cold running water, and drain again.

Pound the drained banana blossom, papaya, great morinda, star gooseberries, scallions, both kinds of cilantro, shallots, dried shrimp, sugar, chili flakes, fermented fish sauce, fish sauce, and lead tree seeds together in a mortar with a pestle. Serve on a bed of lettuce leaves.

recipes.searchText: Mixed Fruit and Vegetable Salad Northeast 2 teaspoons white vinegar 1 small banana blossom 175 g julienned green papaya 175 g julienned great morinda fruit 180 g star gooseberries 6 scallions (spring onions), sliced 25 g chopped cilantro (coriander) 25 g chopped sawtooth cilantro (coriander) 2 shallots, sliced 2 tablespoons dried shrimp 2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes 120 ml fermented fish sauce, boiled 2 tablespoons fish sauce 3 tablespoons lead tree seeds lettuce leaves, to serve Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 11⁄2 teaspoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Finely pound the garlic and chiles in a mortar with a pestle.
Add the beans and pound coarsely.
Add the lime juice, sugar, salted crab, tomato, eggplant, dried shrimp, and fermented fish sauce.
Coarsely pound and mix with the pestle until thoroughly combined, then serve.

recipes.searchText: Yard-Long Bean Salad Northeast 2 cloves garlic 8 red bird's eye chiles 150 g coarsely chopped yard-long beans 11⁄2 teaspoons lime juice 11⁄2 teaspoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 salted crab, carapace removed (optional) 1 tomato, quartered lengthwise 1 round eggplant (aubergine), sliced 1 tablespoon dried shrimp 1 tablespoon fermented fish sauce Finely pound the garlic and chiles in a mortar with a pestle. Add the beans and pound coarsely. Add the lime juice, sugar, salted crab, tomato, eggplant, dried shrimp, and fermented fish sauce. recipes.title: Spicy Pomelo Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 11⁄2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Cook the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes, or until pink, then drain and set aside.
Cook the pork in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside.
Dry-fry the coconut in a skillet or frying pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 1-2 minutes, or until light brown. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside.
To make the dressing, put the sugar, salt, chili flakes, and coconut milk in a bowl and mix until the sugar has dissolved. Set aside.

Peel the pomelo and cut the flesh into segments. Remove and discard the pith and membrane, then break the flesh into small pieces and transfer to a large bowl. Add the dried shrimp, cooked shrimp, coconut, peanuts, garlic, and dressing and gently toss until well mixed.
Transfer to a serving plate, sprinkle with the cashew nuts, fried shallots, and chopped cilantro, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Pomelo Salad Central 10 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined 100 g ground (minced) pork 45 g dry unsweetened (desiccated) coconut 11⁄2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon dried chili flakes 7 tablespoons coconut milk 1 pomelo (about 300 g) 50 g dried shrimp, pounded 2 tablespoons peanuts, roasted and crushed 4 cloves garlic, thinly sliced 75 g cashew nuts 3 tablespoons Fried Shallots (see p. 64) 1 handful cilantro (coriander), chopped Cook the shrimp in a pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes, or until pink, then drain and set aside. Cook the pork in another pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes, then drain and set aside. Dry-fry the coconut in a skillet or frying pan over medium heat, stirring frequently, for 1-2 minutes, or until light brown. Transfer to a small bowl and set aside. Add the dried shrimp, cooked shrimp, coconut, peanuts, garlic, and dressing and gently toss until well mixed. recipes.title: Papaya Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
1 yard-long bean, cut into 4 cm lengths
To serve Glutinous Rice (see p. 378) Grilled Chicken (see p. 276)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Add the tomatoes, lime juice, fermented fish sauce, fish sauce, sugar, crabmeat, and bean, then use a spoon and the pestle to lightly pound and mix together until the sugar has dissolved. Add the papaya and pound to mis well. Serve with rice and grilled chicken.

recipes.searchText: Papaya Salad Northeast 3-5 red bird's eye chiles, sliced 1 clove garlic, sliced 2 tomatoes, sliced 1 tablespoon lime juice 1 tablespoon fermented fish sauce 11⁄2 teaspoons fish sauce 1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 salted crab, carapace removed (optional) 1 yard-long bean, cut into 4 cm lengths 250 g shredded green papaya To serve Glutinous Rice (see p. 378) Grilled Chicken (see p. 276) Coarsely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Add the tomatoes, lime juice, fermented fish sauce, fish sauce, sugar, crabmeat, and bean, then use a spoon and the pestle to lightly pound and mix together until the sugar has dissolved. Add the papaya and pound to mis well. Serve with rice and grilled chicken.

recipes.title: Papaya and Fish Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 75 g pickled cabbage, cut into small pieces
120 ml boiled shellfish, cut into small pieces

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Finely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Add the papaya, bean sprouts, pickled cabbage, shellfish, dried shrimp, fermented rice noodles, cilantro (coriander), tomatoes, roasted peanuts, and lead tree seeds. Season with the salt, fish sauces, and lime juice and mix until thoroughly combined. Serve.

recipes.searchText: Papaya and Fish Salad Northeast 5 red bird's-eye chiles 5 cloves garlic 200 g julienned green papaya 25 g bean sprouts 75 g pickled cabbage, cut into small pieces 120 ml boiled shellfish, cut into small pieces 25 g dried shrimp 150 g cooked fermented rice noodles 5 sawtooth cilantro (coriander) leaves, finely chopped 3 tomatoes, diced 15 g roasted peanuts 100 g lead tree seeds 1⁄2 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon boiled fermented fish sauce 1 teaspoon fish sauce 1 tablespoon lime juice Finely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Season with the salt, fish sauces, and lime juice and mix until thoroughly combined. Serve.

recipes.title: Green Papaya Salad
recipes.subtitle: Northeast

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 yard-long bean, cut into 4 cm lengths
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
120 g julienned green papaya Grilled Chicken (see p. 276), to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle. Add the yard-long bean and lightly crush.
Add the tomatoes, sugar, peanuts, dried shrimp, lime juice, lime wedges, and fish sauce. Gently mix until the sugar dissolves.
Add the papaya and mix together. Serve on its own or with grilled chicken.

recipes.searchText: Green Papaya Salad Northeast 3 bird's-eye chiles 3 cloves garlic 1 yard-long bean, cut into 4 cm lengths 2 tomatoes, cut into small pieces 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 tablespoon roasted peanuts 1 tablespoon dried shrimp 1 tablespoon lime juice 2 limes, cut into wedges 1 tablespoon fish sauce 120 g julienned green papaya Grilled Chicken (see p. 276), to serve Pound the chiles and garlic together in a mortar with a pestle. ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 3-5 red and green bird's eye chiles
1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
1 salted duck egg, quartered, to garnish lettuce leaves, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Blanch the senna leaves in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Drain and set aside.
Pound the chiles and garlic finely in a mortar. Season with the lime juice, tamarind, sugar, and fish sauce, balancing the dressing to taste sour, salty, and sweet.
Add the senna leaves, dried shrimp, papaya, carrot, tomato, eggplant, and peanuts and mix well. Transfer to a lettuce-lined plate, garnish with the salted egg, and serve.

recipes.searchText: Senna Leaf and Papaya Salad Northeast 30 g Senna sophera leaves 3-5 red and green bird's eye chiles 3 cloves garlic 1 tablespoon lime juice 1 teaspoon Tamarind Puree (see p. 63) 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar 1 tablespoon fish sauce 2 tablespoons dried shrimp 175 g julienned green papaya 50 g julienned carrot 1 tomato, sliced 1 round eggplant (aubergine), sliced 3 tablespoons roasted peanuts 1 salted duck egg, quartered, to garnish lettuce leaves, to serve Blanch the senna leaves in a pan of boiling water for 1 minute. Add the senna leaves, dried shrimp, papaya, carrot, tomato, eggplant, and peanuts and mix well. Transfer to a lettuce-lined plate, garnish with the salted egg, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Blue Crab and Papaya Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 live blue crabs, about 300 g each, cleaned
1 yard-long bean, cut into 5-7.5 cm pieces
11⁄2 teaspoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
25 g cashew nuts, roasted raw vegetables, such as yard-long beans and napa (Chinese) cabbage, to serve

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Put the crabs in the freezer for 20 minutes, then remove and put them in a large bowl.

Take one crab and place it on a cutting board. Turn the crab onto its back with its legs facing upward. Raise the tail flap and push a small screwdriver or skewer through the hole underneath. Press firmly down on the screwdriver handle until it reaches the other side of the shell. Remove the screwdriver and repeat with the remaining crab.
Remove the crab apron and carapace and rinse until clean. Cut each crab in half vertically, then cut each piece horizontally. Remove the claws, crush them, and set aside.
Blanch the crab pieces and claws in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked, then drain and set aside.

Finely pound the chiles and garlic in a mortar with a pestle. Add the papaya, tomatoes, and yard-long bean and pound again. Add the crab and lightly pound and stir at the same time with the pestle and a spoon.
Add the fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with the cashew nuts. Serve with raw vegetables.

Add the fish sauce, sugar, and lime juice and mix well. Transfer to a serving plate and sprinkle with the cashew nuts. Serve with raw vegetables.

recipes.title: Durian Salad
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 3 celery stalks, cut into 2.5 cm lengths

ingredientGroups.heading: For the chili sauce
lines: 2 tablespoons finely sliced red and green bird's eye chiles

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Peel the durian, cut the flesh into 4 cm lengths, and cut it again into matchsticks.
For the chili sauce, mix the lime juice, fish sauce, salt, sugar, and chiles in a bowl.
Put the durian, pork, carrot, scallions, and celery in a large bowl. Pour over the chili sauce and mix well. Serve.

For the chili sauce, mix the lime juice, fish sauce, salt, sugar, and chiles in a bowl. Put the durian, pork, carrot, scallions, and celery in a large bowl. Pour over the chili sauce and mix well. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Mango and Coconut Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 11⁄2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
300 g sour green mango, peeled and finely sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the dried shrimp to fine flakes in a mortar with a pestle and set aside.
Dry-fry the coconut in a wok over low-medium heat, stirring frequently, for about 2 minutes, until golden brown. Let cool.
Stir the coconut milk, salt, sugar, and shrimp paste together in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Add the mango, dried shrimp, toasted coconut, shallots, and chiles and mix well. Transfer to a plate and serve.

Transfer to a plate and serve.

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 x 500 g sour green mangoes, peeled

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Slice the mangoes lengthwise into 5 mm-thick slices, then soak in a bowl of cold water for 2-3 minutes, until firm and crunchy.
Mix the chili powder, sugar, and salt in a small bowl. Serve as a dry dip with the mango slices.

recipes.searchText: Mango Salad with Chili Dip Northeast 2 x 500 g sour green mangoes, peeled 1-2 teaspoons chili powder 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 1 teaspoon salt Slice the mangoes lengthwise into 5 mm-thick slices, then soak in a bowl of cold water for 2-3 minutes, until firm and crunchy. recipes.title: Spicy Fruit Salad

Add the sugar, fish sauce, and lime juice and mix until the sugar dissolves.
Add the remaining ingredients and gently mix the fruit with the dressing. Serve.

recipes.title: Spicy Strawberry Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 tablespoons jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the chiles in a mortar with a pestle.
Mix the garlic, lime juice, fish sauce, sugar, dried shrimp, and pounded chiles in a bowl. Add the strawberries and tomato, mix, and serve.

recipes.title: Phuket Pineapple Salad
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 80 g skinless and boneless chicken breast
8 uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, with tails intact
1 tablespoon Fried Shallots (see p. 64) lettuce leaves, to serve

ingredientGroups.heading: For the dressing
lines: 1 tablespoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Cut off the pineapple stem, then cut across the top 2-3 cm from the crown and set it aside. Use a long, thin knife to loosen the flesh, then scoop it out to leave a hollow pineapple bowl. Cut 150 g pineapple flesh into 2 cm cubes.
Cook the chicken breast in a pan of boiling water for 2-3 minutes, or until cooked. Remove with a slotted spoon and let cool, then tear into shreds.
Cook the shrimp in another pan of boiling water for 1-2 minutes, or until pink. Drain and set aside.
Dry-fry the coconut in a wok over medium heat for 2-3 minutes, or until light brown. Remove and set aside.
For the dressing, stir all the dressing ingredients together in a large bowl until the sugar dissolves.
Add the pineapple, shrimp, chicken, peanuts, dried shrimp, coconut, and scallions and gently mix until combined.
Spoon into the pineapple bowl, sprinkle with the fried shallots, and serve with lettuce leaves.

recipes.title: Spicy Banana Blossom Salad

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 10 uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails intact
3-5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped
4 tablespoons Fried Shallots (see p. 64), to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. Peel away and discard the outer red petals and the small white flowers from the banana blossom. Cut off the tip and base, split the blossom lengthwise, then cut each half in half again. Put the quarters in the vinegar water.

Blanch the sliced banana blossom in boiling water for 10-15 seconds. Drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again.

Mix the chili jam with 3 tablespoons coconut milk. Add the sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, chiles, peanuts, and shallot and mix well.
Add the banana blossom and shrimp and toss well. Garnish with the fried shallots and serve with the quartered egg.

recipes.searchText: Spicy Banana Blossom Salad Central 2 teaspoons white vinegar 1 banana blossom 10 uncooked shrimp, peeled and deveined, tails intact 1 tablespoon Chili Jam (see p. 35) 75 ml coconut milk 11⁄2 tablespoons granulated sugar 2 tablespoons fish sauce 2 tablespoons lime juice 3-5 red and green bird's-eye chiles, chopped 3 tablespoons roasted unsalted peanuts, crushed 1 shallot, sliced 4 tablespoons Fried Shallots (see p. 64), to garnish 1 hard-boiled egg, quartered, to serve Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. Peel away and discard the outer red petals and the small white flowers from the banana blossom. Cut off the tip and base, split the blossom lengthwise, then cut each half in half again. Put the quarters in the vinegar water. Peel and clean each layer, discarding the flowers inside. Slice the petals 5 mm thick and return them to the vinegar water. Repeat until all the petals are sliced, then drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again. Blanch the sliced banana blossom in boiling water for 10-15 seconds. Drain, rinse under cold water, and drain again. Cook the shrimp in boiling water for 1-2 minutes, then drain. Mix the chili jam with 3 tablespoons coconut milk. Add the sugar, fish sauce, lime juice, chiles, peanuts, and shallot and mix well. Add the banana blossom and shrimp and toss well. Garnish with the fried shallots and serve with the quartered egg.

recipes.title: Chicken and Banana Blossom Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 2 skinless, boneless chicken breasts, chopped into bite-size pieces
10 kaffir lime leaves, torn, to garnish
3 lemongrass stalks, finely chopped, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Fill a large bowl with water and add the vinegar. Peel away and discard the outer red petals and the small white banana flowers. Trim the tip and base of the blossom, quarter it lengthwise, and place the pieces in the vinegar water.
Peel and clean each layer, discarding the flowers inside. Slice the layers 5 mm thick and return them to the vinegar water. Repeat until the whole blossom is prepared.
Heat the oil in a wok over medium heat. Add the garlic and chili paste and stir-fry for 1 minute. Add 750 ml water and bring to a boil.
Add the shallots and chicken, return to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.

Drain and rinse the banana blossom, then add it to the wok and cook for 5 minutes. Add the sawtooth cilantro, scallions, cilantro, Vietnamese cilantro, galangal, and peppermint and cook for 3 minutes.
Garnish with the kaffir lime leaves and lemongrass and serve.

recipes.title: Indian Trumpet Flower Pod Spicy Salad
recipes.subtitle: North

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 teaspoon chili powder peppermint leaves, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Dry-fry the flower pod in a wok over medium heat for about 5 minutes, until toasted. Let cool slightly, remove the outer layer, and rinse under cold running water.
Slice the pod into 5 mm pieces. Put it in a bowl with the salt, lime juice, fish sauce, ground toasted rice, scallion, sawtooth cilantro, kaffir lime leaves, and chili powder and toss gently.
Garnish with peppermint leaves and serve.

recipes.title: Egg Tofu and Ground Pork Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 bunch cilantro (coriander) leaves, coarsely chopped, to garnish

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: For the egg tofu, combine the soy milk and salt in a bowl. Add the eggs and whisk gently, avoiding bubbles. Pour into a shallow dish to a depth of about 4 cm. Steam over very low heat for 12-15 minutes, or until firm, then cut into 3 x 3 x 1.5 cm pieces. The egg tofu can be refrigerated for 2-3 days.
Combine the pork and Saam-Gler in a bowl. Add 1 tablespoon of the soy sauce and mix well, then shape into small balls.

Bring the broth and 475 ml water to a boil in a pan. Add the pork balls and simmer for 2-3 minutes, or until they float. Add the salt and remaining soy sauce, then add the egg tofu and celery and cook for 2 minutes. Garnish with cilantro and serve.

recipes.title: Fermented Fish and Jackfruit Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 broiled (grilled) sea bass or sea bream, cut into bite-size pieces
1 kg young jackfruit, peeled and seeded wearing gloves, and cut into 2.5 cm slices
100 g jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the shallots, garlic, fingerroot, and lemongrass thoroughly in a mortar with a pestle until smooth. Add the broiled (grilled) fish and pound until combined. Bring the coconut milk to a boil in another pan over medium heat, add the pounded fish paste and the fermented fish, return to a boil, and add the pork Return to a boil and add the jackfruit then continue to boil for 5 minutes until cooked. Add the salt, fish sauce, sugar, tamarind, and kaffir lime leaves and stir. Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

recipes.title: Mullet Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 piece fresh ginger, about 7 cm, peeled and sliced
1 piece galangal, about 7.5 cm, peeled and sliced
1 gray mullet or red snapper, about 500 g, cleaned, descaled, and cut into 5 cm pieces
75 ml mangrove palm vinegar, white wine vinegar, or Tamarind Puree (see p. 63)

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 960 ml water to a boil in a large pan. Add the ginger, galangal, lemongrass, chiles, and shallots, return to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Carefully add the fish and cook for another 5 minutes. Season with the vinegar and salt. Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

recipes.searchText: Mullet Soup Central 1 piece fresh ginger, about 7 cm, peeled and sliced 1 piece galangal, about 7.5 cm, peeled and sliced 11⁄2 lemongrass stalks, sliced 2 shallots, thinly sliced 1 gray mullet or red snapper, about 500 g, cleaned, descaled, and cut into 5 cm pieces 4-5 red bird's-eye chiles, finely chopped 75 ml mangrove palm vinegar, white wine vinegar, or Tamarind Puree (see p. 63) 1⁄2 teaspoon salt Bring 960 ml water to a boil in a large pan. recipes.title: Spicy-and-Sour Mackerel Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 400-500 g horse mackerel, cleaned and descaled
10 green and red bird's-eye chiles, sliced

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring the broth to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the salt, lemongrass, garlic, and kaffir lime leaves and boil for 2-3 minutes.
Add the fish sauce and lime juice, stir, and increase the heat to high. Add the mackerel and return to a boil without stirring.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook for another 2-3 minutes. Add the chiles and cilantro and stir. Ladle into soup bowls and serve hot.

recipes.title: Sweet-and-Sour Mackerel Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 5 small whole mackerel, cleaned and descaled
1 x 2.5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Pound the cilantro roots, salt, shrimp paste, and shallots together in a mortar with a pestle.
Bring the broth or water to a boil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the pounded mixture, stir, and return to a boil.
Add the tamarind, sugar, and fish sauce and return to a boil. Add the mackerel and cook for about 10 minutes.
Add the ginger and scallions and stir. Ladle into soup bowls, sprinkle with the dried chiles, and serve.

recipes.title: Sea Bass Soup with Cardamom Shoots
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 500 g sea bass fillet, cut into 4 cm pieces
200 g Siam cardamom shoots, cut into 4 cm lengths

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring a large pan of water to a boil. Add the sea bass, cardamom shoots, and salacca (snake fruit).
Return to a boil and add the kaffir lime leaves, fish sauce, lime juice, chiles, and cilantro. Cook for 3-4 minutes.
Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

recipes.title: Sea Bass in Herb Soup
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 teaspoon jaggery, palm sugar, or soft light brown sugar
500 g sea bass fillets, cut into bite-size chunks

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Bring 475 ml water to a boil in a large pan. Add the fish sauce, shrimp paste, shallots, and garlic and return to a boil.
Add the tamarind sauce and sugar and return to a boil. Add the sea bass and cook for 3-5 minutes.
Remove from the heat and add the sweet basil, star gooseberry, and hairy basil leaves. Ladle into soup bowls and serve.

recipes.title: Sea Bass and Rice Soup
recipes.subtitle: Central

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 1 x 300 g sea bass, cleaned, filleted, and cut into 3-4 cm slices, bones reserved

ingredientGroups.heading: To garnish
lines: 5 cm piece fresh ginger, peeled and julienned

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Soak the shiitake mushrooms in warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze dry, cut into quarters, and set aside.
Bring the chicken broth and 350 ml water to a boil in a large pan over high heat. Add the galangal, garlic, black pepper, and fish bones and boil for 4-5 minutes without stirring.
Strain through a fine strainer into a clean pan. Return to a boil over medium heat, add the soy sauce, fish sauce, and shiitake mushrooms, and stir.
Return to a boil, add the sea bass, and cook for 2 minutes without stirring, or until the fish is cooked. Add the rice and celery and boil for another 1-2 minutes.
Ladle into soup bowls, garnish with fried garlic, scallions, cilantro, and ginger, and serve.

recipes.title: Spicy-and-Sour Soup with Egg Noodles
recipes.subtitle: South

ingredientGroups.heading: Ingredients
lines: 100 g squid, halved and tentacles removed
4 uncooked shrimp (prawns), peeled and deveined, tails intact

methodGroups.heading: Method
steps: Rinse the sea bass and pat dry. Put it in a pan with enough water to cover by about 1 inch (2.5 cm) and bring to a boil. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes, until cooked, then drain.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 1 minute, or according to the package directions. Drain, transfer to a serving bowl, and set aside.

Put the galangal, kaffir lime leaves, lemongrass, shallots, mushrooms, tomatoes, squid, shrimp, and cooked fish in a large pan. Add the Chili Jam, salt, lime juice, fish sauce, and milk. Pour in the chicken broth, bring to a simmer, and cook for about 3 minutes, until hot. Pour over the noodles, garnish with cilantro, and serve.
